name: Alampur (derived built-up extent from building footprints)
licence: derived from Overture Maps buildings (ODbL 1.0; see the release in the provenance file)
study_area_type: settlement boundary of Alampur town, Alampur mandal, Jogulamba Gadwal district (type fixed by --pick; see the provenance file)
boundary_type: DERIVED built-up settlement extent (NOT an administrative boundary)

derivation.window_m: 12 km x 12 km computation window around the centre (not the study area)
derivation.method: footprints grouped into clusters over gaps <= 250 m, clusters reaching within 1.2 km of the centre kept, outline = footprints buffered +60 m then -40 m (about 20 m outside the outermost buildings), simplified, outlying built-up parts kept; clipped only to the search area

covers.localities_source: Overture divisions points inside the polygon, release 2026-11-18.0

note: Alampur is mapped in OpenStreetMap only as a place=town node (15.87996 N, 78.13508 E): no polygon exists in OSM, Nominatim or the Overture divisions, and no LGD / Census village polygon is available to the project. The study area is therefore the settlement extent derived from Overture building footprints around that node (checked against Esri imagery).
